detail.title: Emergent Properties in Curiosity-Driven Exploration
detail.summary: Investigating whether curiosity-driven exploration in artificial systems constitutes an emergent property of active inference models. Research and synthesis are proceeding under the 'emergence' focus topic. Current belief synthesis suggests curiosity arises from predictive mismatch mitigation across multi-agent interactions, which aligns with active inference frameworks.
